description: Get market participants Lists teams, players, or result sides for the requested event and markets. Use `participant_id` from this response, rather than `id`, to filter a participant-specific chart. Market `3` totals use `TYPE_RESULT` Over and Under participants, while markets `1` and `2` use `TYPE_TEAM` participants. For example, discover totals with `GET /api/v2/markets/participants?event_id=733a06aa4f4f2a3af7872c3667a60f22&market_ids=3&participant_type=TYPE_RESULT`, then request each discovered side from `GET /api/v2/events/{eventID}/markets/{marketID}/history`. Read-only Product data or price calculation. Use returned canonical IDs. Access, delay and metered usage follow your connected account; never infer coverage from an empty result. One bounded request, no background polling or automatic retry. Affiliate 27 is excluded. No wagers, account changes or guarantee of returns.

event_id.description: Canonical V2 event ID that scopes participant discovery.

market_ids.description: Comma-separated market IDs. Defaults to `1,2,3` when omitted. Comma-separated integer IDs; maximum 12, unique, no spaces or encoded aliases.

participant_ids.description: Comma-separated public canonical participant IDs to return. Comma-separated integer IDs; maximum 50, unique, no spaces or encoded aliases.

name: v2GetMarketsParticipants
title: Get market participants
